title: Lines are kept if the note or Audit Log fails, deleted records handled
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit' and 'Work orders - Create & Edit', on the build under test; ShopCoach is enabled and the shop has at least one labor type.
  2. A completed inspection with at least one Monitor or Not OK finding, run on a work order. Seed it: open a work order (Work Orders > New, pick a customer and unit), start an inspection from a template with a checkbox field, mark one field Not OK and one Monitor, then complete and sign it.
  3. Complete a build (lines added). Have a note that can be deleted, an inspection that can be deleted, and a work order that can be split.
custom_steps:
1. Note for the tester: forcing the note or the Audit Log entry to fail to write cannot be done by hand — it is a developer/automated check. By hand, confirm the normal case: after a build, both the note and the Audit Log entry are written and the created lines are present.
2. Delete the note; confirm the Audit Log entry remains.
3. Delete the inspection later; confirm the Audit Log keeps the inspection name as recorded and the link fails gracefully rather than breaking the Audit Log.
4. Split the work order; confirm the note and Audit Log entry stay on the original and the new work order carries no inspection provenance.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • If either record cannot be written, the created lines are kept and the build still reports success.
  • If a user deletes the note, the Audit Log entry remains.
  • If the inspection is later deleted, the Audit Log keeps the inspection name as recorded and the link fails gracefully rather than breaking the Audit Log.
  • If the work order is later split, the note and the Audit Log entry stay on the original, and the new work order carries no inspection provenance.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9105 (S7 — Record where the lines came from); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S7; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-E1: “If either record cannot be written, the created lines are kept and the build still reports success. The lines are the valuable output”
  • S7-E2: “If a user deletes the note, the Audit Log entry remains”
  • S7-E3: “If the inspection is later deleted, the Audit Log entry keeps the inspection name as recorded, and the link fails gracefully rather than breaking the Audit Log”
  • S7-E4: “If the work order is later split, the note and the Audit Log entry stay on the original. The new work order carries no inspection provenance, because a split moves lines and does not copy records”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
